_comment: Hand-written user prompts that deliberately sit between two or more werkstoff components. `router` is which selection the prompt exercises: `skill` (skills and commands, chosen by skill-listing match) or `agent` (Agent-tool subagent_type). `between` records the components the author expected to collide; it is NOT given to the router and is only used to label the report.
